task: Pick up the red bell pepper from the table and place it into the bin.

intervals.start: The gripper has not yet grabbed the red bell pepper, and its tip is about 3 cm away from the red bell pepper.
intervals.end: The gripper closes and has just fully gripped the red bell pepper, slightly lifting it up.

intervals.start: The red bell pepper is placed on the shelf. The right arm's gripper has not yet grabbed the red bell pepper, and its tip is about 3 cm away from the red bell pepper.
intervals.end: The right arm's gripper closes and has just fully gripped the red bell pepper, slightly lifting it up.

intervals.start: The gripper is holding the red bell pepper and moves it to about 3 cm above the bin.
intervals.end: The right arm's gripper releases the red bell pepper so that it just lands into the bin.

intervals.label: The gripper grabs the red bell pepper from the table.
The right arm grabs the red bell pepper from the shelf.
The gripper places the red bell pepper into the bin.
